title: Game-time progression
inputs: Observe a visible in-game clock against a monotonic real-time timer
Run at least 30 real minutes without sleep, teleport, save mutation or pause ambiguity
Repeat after a normal reload and document any discontinuities
expected: Reload continuity and any scheduled discontinuities
toleranceNotes: Three long observations. Timing uncertainty must include clock display granularity and human marker reaction.
